statement: This record remains negative evidence on build 26200.8246: the repo did not produce enough supporting proof to promote it into a normal actionable surface.

anticheat_risk.anticheat_details: DPC watchdog bugcheck behavior is a safety-sensitive kernel diagnostic surface and should be treated as anti-cheat/DRM review-required.

gating_reason: Cross-layer evidence is strong, but an explicit policy or supportability gate still blocks promotion.

links.title: Repo system docs assign ForceBugcheckForDpcWatchdog = 0
links.summary: Repo docs assign `ForceBugcheckForDpcWatchdog = 0` and map it to `KiForceBugcheckForDpcWatchdog` under `Session Manager\\Kernel`.

links.title: Observed baseline existence for ForceBugcheckForDpcWatchdog
links.summary: The observed clean baseline confirmed that `HKLM\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\Session Manager\\Kernel` exists while `ForceBugcheckForDpcWatchdog` itself is absent.

links.title: Current-build string hit for ForceBugcheckForDpcWatchdog
links.summary: The broad current-build string batch found an exact Unicode hit for `ForceBugcheckForDpcWatchdog` in `C:\\Windows\\System32\\ntoskrnl.exe`.

links.title: Lightweight runtime batch wrote ForceBugcheckForDpcWatchdog = 1 and rebooted once
links.summary: The tools-hardened lightweight runtime batch wrote `ForceBugcheckForDpcWatchdog = 1`, rebooted once, preserved shell health, and still returned `zero-exact-target-hits` for this specific candidate in the compact runtime results.

links.title: Dedicated KVM local-KD symbol family bundle resolves KiForceBugcheckForDpcWatchdog = 0
links.summary: A dedicated live KVM local-KD symbol family bundle resolved the surrounding DPC watchdog symbol cluster and directly read `nt!KiForceBugcheckForDpcWatchdog = 0` on the running current build.

links.title: Boot WPR captured Session Manager Kernel QueryValue context but no exact runtime read for ForceBugcheckForDpcWatchdog
links.summary: A KVM boot WPR registry trace produced a saved ETL and a large tracerpt CSV. The retained context window shows `Open` for `Session Manager\\Kernel` followed by `QueryValue` for `DefaultHeteroCpuPolicy`, proving this CSV format can render exact value-name reads under the same key family. Whole-file filtering found no exact `ForceBugcheckForDpcWatchdog` hit, so this lane is retained as stronger negative runtime evidence and no exact runtime read proof.
